description: Team member grid with avatar + name + role + optional bio + social links. Use real photos and full names — fake team grids erode trust faster than no team grid. Two layouts: 'grid' (default, photo above name) and 'compact' (photo left, text right — denser, more list-like).

title.hint: 3-7 words. Often 'Meet the team' / 'Who we are' / 'Our partners'.

members.type: array<{ name, role, bio?, avatar?, links? }>
members.hint: Each: { name, role (title + department, 2-5 words), bio (1-2 sentences), avatar: { src, alt }, links: [{ label, href, icon (twitter|linkedin|github|email|site) }] }. 2-12 members; use columns prop to control layout.
